ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white/light grey) to 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs occupy the outer distal regions of both lobes. The left lobe contains a consolidated white patch with internal dark mottling towards the center. The right lobe displays a more fragmented white region interspersed with dark, finger-like projections extending from the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A wide V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 1/8th the vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations across the entire trailing edge. Pixel amplitude of variations is highest on the right lobe, featuring jagged peaks up to 15 pixels in depth, while the left lobe displays finer, more consistent serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge leading to pointed distal tips, with the right tip appearing more blunted due to localized anomalies.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 12 discrete, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters scattered across the dark central and lower-left regions of the fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple prominent vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) are visible; at least four distinct parallel white lines are located in the central dark region, and several intersecting lines appear on the upper portions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, irregular, high-contrast textured mass is present on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe, consistent with a dense cluster of sessile organisms.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine, high-contrast black 'tiger-stripe' striations are visible within the white pigment patches near the distal-most edges of both lobes.
